text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Monday, July 23, 2018 Posted by admin on July 23rd, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Microsoft (MSFT) and Visa (V). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -2 points.
Friday the Dow was down -6.38 (-0.03%) at 25,058.12.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +1.40%.
There were 13 Dow stocks up Friday.
The Dow stock winners Friday were led by Microsoft (MSFT) +1.79% and JPMorgan (JPM) +1.26%.
The Dow stock losers Friday were led by IBM (IBM) -1.94% and Caterpillar (CAT) -1.86%.
Walgreens Boots Alliance (WBA +0.08%) was downgraded to ‘Market Perform’ from ‘Outperform’ at Cowen.
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended mostly higher.
The national average price of gasoline is down two-tenths of a cent at $2.841 per gallon.
